{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rapid Recharge electronics package''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] electronics package under development at [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Use of the package was forbidden after it was discovered that it sped up weapons recharging to the point where the primary capacitor housing would melt.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' {{1st}}
